name: listig
description: Mobile first delade listor – client/ (React + Vite) och server/ (Node + Hono)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix client
